documents.title: Flood Zone Determination Letter
documents.submission_desk: Division of Engineering, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817 (732-248-7288)
documents.official_summary: Official Township of Edison Flood Zone Determination Letter Request Form. Used by property owners, buyers, and lenders to obtain formal written determination from the Division of Engineering regarding whether a property is located in a FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area (SFHA) per current Flood Insurance Rate Maps (FIRM). Requires Block, Lot, property address, contact details, and $25 Flood Letter Fee.

documents.title: Permit Flow Chart to Help Determine What Permit is Needed
documents.submission_desk: Division of Engineering / Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Official Township of Edison Permit Flow Charts to help determine what municipal permit is needed for property projects. Outlines decision trees for Road Opening (Public Works), Tree Removal (Engineering), Soil Importation and Exportation (Engineering), and Site Improvement Permits (Engineering).

documents.title: Requirements for Plot Grading Plans – Minor Development
documents.fee_summary: Engineering review fee plus 5% construction cost inspection escrow
documents.submission_desk: Division of Engineering, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Official Edison Township Requirements for Plot Grading Plans on Minor Developments. Mandatory for new dwellings, additions, in-ground pools, retaining walls, or projects disturbing 1,250+ sq.ft. or adding 500+ sq.ft. impervious coverage. Must be prepared, signed, and sealed by a NJ licensed PE or PLS, overlaid on certified boundary survey, with contours, spot elevations, on-site stormwater infiltration (seepage pits per Title 34), and soil erosion sediment control measures.

documents.title: Requirements for Plot Grading Plans – Minor Development / Soil Exportation Permit Application
documents.fee_summary: Standard municipal soil exportation fee schedule
documents.submission_desk: Division of Engineering, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Official Edison Township municipal application and guidelines for how to export soil, removing excess excavated soil, dirt, or fill from properties in Edison Township. Under Chapter 31, exporting 10 cubic yards or more requires a Soil Exportation Permit from the Division of Engineering. Removing less than 10 cubic yards does not require a soil permit. Requires topographical survey with cut/fill calculations by NJ licensed surveyor/engineer, soil erosion certification, designated truck haul routes, and filing fees/restoration bonds.

documents.title: Sewer Connection Charge Application
documents.service_or_permit_name: Sewer Connection Allocation & Lateral Tap Permit
documents.fee_summary: Calculated by total fixture units per municipal rate schedule
documents.submission_desk: Edison Sewer Utility Division / Division of Engineering, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817 (sewer@edisonnj.gov)
documents.official_summary: Application for municipal sanitary sewer main tap-in, fixture unit allocation, and connection charge calculations for new dwellings or commercial developments. Requires civil engineering utility connection plan.

documents.title: Site Improvement Permit with Checklist
documents.fee_summary: Engineering review fee plus 5% construction cost inspection escrow
documents.submission_desk: Division of Engineering, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Official Edison Township Site Improvement Permit Application and 25-point engineering checklist for site improvements, property improvements, ground disturbance exceeding 1,250 sq.ft., or new impervious coverage exceeding 500 sq.ft. Requires two (2) signed and sealed engineering site plans, stormwater runoff management, and review fees.

documents.title: Soil Importation Permit Application
documents.fee_summary: $50.00 application fee plus engineering escrow for 10+ cu. yds
documents.submission_desk: Division of Engineering, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Official Edison Township municipal application and guidelines for how to import soil, bringing soil, topsoil, or clean fill onto residential or commercial properties in Edison Township. Under Chapter 31, importing 10 cubic yards or more requires a Soil Importation Permit from the Division of Engineering. Importing less than 10 cubic yards does not require a soil permit. Requires certified clean fill lab analysis, property survey with proposed grading, and designated truck haul route.

documents.title: Tree Removal Permit Application
documents.fee_summary: $25 standard residential review fee (waived for senior citizens aged 62+); $200 with board approval
documents.submission_desk: Division of Engineering, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Official Township of Edison municipal application for tree removal, replacement, and conservation permits under Chapter 25 of the Edison Township Code. Requires property sketch showing tree location and diameter, contractor details, and $25 review fee ($200 with board approval, waived for senior citizens aged 62+). Emergency removals permitted with photo proof or certified arborist letter submitted concurrently.

documents.title: Township of Edison Street Opening Application
documents.fee_summary: $150.00 filing fee + $5,000.00 refundable restoration guarantee bond
documents.submission_desk: Department of Public Works, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817 (dpw@edisonnj.gov)
documents.official_summary: Official Township of Edison Street Opening Application from the Department of Public Works. Permit application for pavement saw-cutting, utility trenching, sidewalk/curb excavation in public right-of-way. Requires NJ 811 One-Call ticket, $5,000 restoration guarantee bond, and traffic safety detour plan if blocking lanes. Submit to Department of Public Works, 100 Municipal Blvd.

documents.title: Edison Township Zoning Permit Requirement Sheet
documents.submission_desk: Division of Zoning, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817 (zoning@edisonnj.gov)
documents.official_summary: Mandatory survey, plot plan scale (1"=20' or 1"=30'), and setback requirements for residential additions, new dwellings, detached garages, sheds over 100 sq.ft., swimming pools, and decks. Submit to Division of Zoning, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817.

documents.title: Township of Edison Official Zoning Permit Application Form
documents.submission_desk: Division of Zoning, Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817 (zoning@edisonnj.gov)
documents.official_summary: Official standardized municipal permit application for single-family residential dwellings, additions, sheds, pools, decks, fences (>6ft), and commercial site changes. Requires 2 copies of signed/sealed survey.

documents.title: Edison Township Zoning Permit Fee Schedule (Ordinance O.2158)
documents.submission_desk: Division of Zoning / Engineering Intake Counter, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Municipal schedule of zoning review fees adopted under Ordinance O.2158: Fences: $50.00; Sheds (< 200 sq.ft.): $50.00; Sheds (> 200 sq.ft.): $100.00; Swimming Pools (Above-Ground): $75.00; In-Ground Pools: $150.00; Residential Addition/Alteration: $100.00; New Single-Family Dwelling: $200.00; Open Deck: $75.00; Commercial Site Plan Review: $500.00 base.

documents.title: Edison Township Swimming Pool Setback & Enclosure Regulations
documents.submission_desk: Division of Zoning, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Zoning rules for private swimming pools: Minimum rear and side setbacks buffer from property lines, mandatory 4-foot minimum barrier enclosure fence with self-closing and self-latching gate, and electrical safety clearance.

documents.title: Edison Township Deck Coverage & Rear Yard Setback Regulation Sheet
documents.submission_desk: Division of Zoning, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Open, unenclosed residential decks may project into required rear yards provided a minimum 15-foot rear yard setback is maintained in R-A, R-B, and R-C zones. Deck area counts toward total parcel maximum impervious lot coverage limits.

documents.title: Edison Township Schedule A: Yard & Bulk Zoning Requirements
documents.submission_desk: Division of Zoning, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Comprehensive municipal yard and bulk dimensional table for Edison residential zones (R-A, R-B, R-C, R-D): Front setback, side yard minimum, combined side yard, rear setback, maximum lot coverage percentage, and maximum building height (35 ft / 2.5 stories).

documents.title: Township of Edison Minor Subdivision Application Packet
documents.submission_desk: Planning Board / Zoning Board Secretary, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Official application packet for dividing a residential property into 3 or fewer lots without new street creation. Requires boundary surveys, certified tax payment certification, 200-foot property owners notice list, and engineering escrow deposit.

documents.title: Township of Edison Official Document Center & Forms Repository
documents.submission_desk: Edison Municipal Complex, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817
documents.official_summary: Centralized municipal public repository for Edison Township, New Jersey. Provides official forms and applications for Engineering, Zoning, Public Works, Health, Township Clerk, and Code Enforcement. Documents must be submitted as unaltered official forms to the Municipal Complex (100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817).
